title: Why you procrastinate (it's not laziness) 🧠
description:
Why do I procrastinate? It's not laziness. Your brain dodges a task that feels bad to get a quick mood boost now, and future you pays for it. Perfect timing for midterm season in the 6ix.

Sources (PubMed):
Johansson et al., JAMA Netw Open 2023 — https://doi.org/10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2022.49346
Zhang et al., WIREs Cogn Sci 2019 — https://doi.org/10.1002/wcs.1492
